[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_data_structures"
version = "1.0.3"
description = "Shared data structures for the demospipes API and core."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "pydantic~=2.13.4",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.14.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.0",
    "bandit[toml]>=1.8.0",
    "mypy>=1.18.0",
]
test = [
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [
    "src",
]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
demospipes_data_structures = [
    "py.typed",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
exclude = [
    ".venv",
    "__pycache__",
====API
[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_api"
version = "1.0.5"
description = "API for DEMOSpipes."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
    "api",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]~=0.136.3",
    "pydantic-settings~=2.14.2",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.14.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.0",
    "bandit[toml]>=1.8.0",
    "mypy>=1.18.0",
]
test = [
    "asgi-lifespan>=2.1.0",
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
    "pytest-mock>=3.15.1",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [
    "src",
]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
demospipes_api = [
    "*.ini",
    "py.typed",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
exclude = [
    ".venv",
    "__pycache__",
    ".git",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
====BMDS-API
[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_addon_bmds_api"
version = "1.0.13"
description = "API for BMDS."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
    "bmds",
    "api",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "demospipes-data-structures",
    "demospipes-addon-bmds-data-structures",
    "fastapi[standard]~=0.136.3",
    "prefect==3.7.4",
    "pydantic~=2.13.4",
    "pydantic-settings~=2.14.1",
]

[project.entry-points."demospipes_addon.api.bmds"]
demospipes_addon_bmds_router = "demospipes_addon_bmds_api:bmds_router"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
]

[tool.setuptools]
packages = [
    "demospipes_addon_bmds_api",
]

[tool.uv.sources.demospipes-data-structures]
path = "../../../data-structures"

[tool.uv.sources.demospipes-addon-bmds-data-structures]
path = "../data_structures"

observation.command: cd /workspace && head -50 02-backend/demospipes/data-structures/pyproject.toml; echo ====API; head -60 02-backend/demospipes/api/pyproject.toml; echo ====BMDS-API; head -50 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/api/pyproject.toml
